coverage_note: No independent complete inundation-study coverage geometry was supplied with this pack. A40 polygons indicate modeled inundation areas only; outside every polygon remains UNKNOWN and must not be described as surveyed, zero-inundation, or safe.

boundary_source.role: Pinned N03 municipality boundary used only for Ishinomaki clipping and package bounds; it is not evidence of tsunami coverage.

inundation.geometry_operation: Each official source polygon was transformed from EPSG:6668 to EPSG:4326 and intersected with the pinned Ishinomaki N03 municipality boundary. No simplification, coordinate rounding, or depth relabeling was applied. Invalid A40 source polygons intersecting the pilot were topologically repaired with Shapely make_valid; the feature IDs are listed above. A 0.01-degree source-CRS envelope prefilter only removes polygons that cannot intersect the municipality; exact clipping uses the full geometry.

places.category_policy: Emergency-site CSV value 1 maps to DESIGNATED and a published blank maps to NOT_DESIGNATED. Missing columns and other nonblank values map to UNKNOWN and retain their distinct source state/raw value. Ordinary shelter CSV has no eight hazard applicability columns, so all eight remain UNKNOWN.
places.open_status_policy: UNKNOWN for every record; GSI designation data does not report current opening.

metadata.review_policy: review_due_at is a local 90-day review checkpoint. It is not an official source publication, freshness, or opening-status date.

scenario.terrain_basis: Post-2011 ground changes and recovery projects as of 2019-12

sources.notes: MLIT A40 listing: https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-A40-v2_1.html; product spec: https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/product_spec/KS-PS-A40-v2_1.pdf. The A40 v2.1 quality section reports horizontal positional standard deviation 25 m based on a 2% sample; this is not a maximum-error guarantee. As checked 2026-10-11, Miyagi's latest listed A40 file is Reiwa 4 (2022). The MLIT page gives the 2022-04-01 basis date and requires Miyagi portal terms. Source properties A40_003 are retained as published.

The catalog metadata lists dataset registration/publication 2022-09-09 and last update 2022-09-22; the prefecture page itself is dated 2022-10-03; the official tsunami assumption was announced 2022-05-10.
